تعتلوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَلُوا (taʕtalū) /taʕ.ta.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# تُعْتَلَوْا (tuʕtalaw) /tuʕ.ta.law/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
